title: Advancing Blackshear Infill Housing Design
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation Board approved an amendment to a contract for engineering design services.
*   These services are specifically designated for the Blackshear Scattered Cooperative Infill Housing Program (SCIP).
*   This decision aims to advance the development of cooperative infill housing projects within the Blackshear area.
transcript:
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
May 28, 1992
The meeting was called to order at 4:45 p.m. by President Bruce Todd.
Present: Bruce Todd, Charles Urdy, Gus Garcia, Ronney Reynolds, Bob Larson
Absent:
Louise Epstein, Max Nofziger
Agenda Item No. One:
Approve minutes of March 26, 1992 and April 14, 1992 meetings
Agenda Item No. Two:
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Urdy's motion and Board Member Larson's second, approved
minutes on 4-0-0 vote with Reynolds out of room and Nofziger and Epstein absent Approve a
resolution for the negotiation and execution of an amendment to a contract with
Baker-Aicken & Associates to perform engineering design services for Blackshear Scattered
Cooperative Infill Housing Program (SCIP) area Motion The Board, on Board Member Urdy's
motion, Board Member Larson's second, approved resolution on a 5-0-0 vote with Nofziger
and Epstein absent
Meeting adjourned at 4:50 p.m.
